title: Causality can systematically address the monsters under the bench(marks)
abstract: arXiv:2502.05085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Effective and reliable evaluation is essential for advancing empirical machine learning. However, the increasing accessibility of generalist models and the progress towards ever more complex, high-level tasks make systematic evaluation more challenging. Benchmarks are plagued by various biases, artifacts, or leakage, while models may behave unreliably due to poorly explored failure modes. Haphazard treatments and inconsistent formulations of such "monsters" leads to a duplication of efforts, a lack of trust in results, and unsupported inferences. In this position paper, we argue causality offers an ideal framework to systematically address these challenges. By making causal assumptions in an approach explicit, we can faithfully model phenomena, formulate testable hypotheses with explanatory power, and leverage principled tools for analysis. translated_title: 因果性可以系统性地解决潜藏在基准测试之下的“怪兽”
translated_abstract: 有效且可靠的评估对于推进实证机器学习至关重要。然而，通用大模型日益普及，以及朝着日益复杂的高层次任务的不断推进，使得系统性评估变得更具挑战性。基准测试受到各种偏差、伪影或数据泄露等问题的困扰，同时由于故障模式未被充分探索，模型可能表现出不可靠的行为。对这类“怪兽”的随意处理和不一致的表述导致了重复劳动、对结果缺乏信任以及缺乏依据的推断。在这篇立场论文中，我们主张因果性为系统性地应对这些挑战提供了一个理想的框架。通过将方法中的因果假设显式化，我们可以忠实地对现象建模、构建具有解释力的可检验假设，并利用有原则性的工具进行分析。为了使概念性因果模型的设计更易于上手，我们识别了几种有用的……
tldr: 这篇立场论文主张，因果性为系统性地解决机器学习基准测试中的偏差、伪影和数据泄露等“怪兽”问题提供了理想框架，通过显式化因果假设并利用有原则的分析工具来提升评估的可信度与一致性。
en_tdlr: This position paper argues that causality provides an ideal framework to systematically address biases, artifacts, and leakage in ML benchmarks by making causal assumptions explicit and leveraging principled analytical tools.
